svg.title: The old-age dependency ratio rose in all twelve selected countries
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: The old-age dependency ratio rose in all twelve selected countries: In 2000: Japan: 25.6%, Italy: 27.0%, Germany: 24.2%, France: 24.6%, United Kingdom: 24.4%, Canada: 18.4%, United States: 18.3%, South Korea: 9.9%, China: 10.3%, Brazil: 7.9%, Türkiye: 9.1%, India: 7.3%; In 2023: Japan: 50.3%, Italy: 38.1%, Germany: 36.0%, France: 35.4%, United Kingdom: 30.4%, Canada: 29.6%, United States: 26.8%, South Korea: 25.9%, China: 20.7%, Brazil: 15.3%, Türkiye: 14.7%, India: 10.2%.
